question: is there free food anywhere on campus today
answer:
Yes. The Civic and Community Engagement Center’s We Care food resources page says these pantry items are free for students: microwave soups and meals, granola and/or breakfast bars, and protein shakes [3]. On Monday, the listed locations/hours include: Learning Commons, 7:45 a.m.–12:00 a.m.; Dean of Students Office, C-212, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; Women’s Center, C-220, 10:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.; EOF Office, D-101, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; Multicultural Center, D-214, 11:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.; Center for Student Success, D-207, and First Generation Student Center, D-210, 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m. [3] Other listed satellite pantry locations are outside Counseling Services in D-216, Black Student Union in SC-277, TAS Mathematics and Science Tutoring Center in G-131, and outside the CCEC in SC 213; hours aren’t listed for these [3]. question: does ramapo have a gaming club or esports team? how do i join
answer:
Yes. Ramapo Esports is listed under Athletics. It is open to all students to learn about, and it offers open events; exclusive membership as an RCNJ Esports Player is for students who try out for the games provided. Contact esports@ramapo.edu or visit https://archway.ramapo.edu/espo/. [1] For more information on esports as a competitive sports club, see Intramural & Club Sports Info: https://ramapoathletics.com/sports/2018/9/26/intramurals-and-competitive-sports-clubs.aspx. [12]

Other gaming groups include Ramapo Girls in Gaming (https://archway.ramapo.edu/gaming/; rgg@ramapo.edu), which hosts meetings, events, game nights, and presentations for female-presenting people and allies who game. [5] Ramapo Smash Club (https://archway.ramapo.edu/SMASH/; smashclub@ramapo.edu) hosts meetings and events for students interested in Super Smash Brothers and other fighting games; its page also lists a Discord: https://discord.gg/YDcNVbJ. [3] Rhythm Game Club (https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/rhythm-game-club/; rrgc@ramapo.edu) welcomes players of all backgrounds, with no experience required. [6][8] Trading Card Game Club welcomes new, casual, and competitive players: https://www.ramapo.edu/clubs/organization/trading-card-game-club/; tcg@ramapo.edu. [9]

The college says all listed clubs are open to students. Contact the Center for Student Involvement for help finding or starting a club: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [7]
